question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: The passage talks Alessandro Volta who was a an Italian physicist famous for his invention of battery. He was born in 1745. He became a professor of Physics at the Roayl School of Como. There he did a research on the chemistry of gases and invented methane in a lake. He travelled many parts of the world including France and Germany. He was made a count by Napolean Bonaparte. This great man passed away in 1827.
